note.overview: This note supports 14 source-backed questions on Miscellaneous words.
mustMemoriseRules: et → and. Learn the meaning together with its grammar clue.
non → not. Learn the meaning together with its grammar clue.
nunc → now. Learn the meaning together with its grammar clue.
sed → but. Learn the meaning together with its grammar clue.
semper → always. Learn the meaning together with its grammar clue.
decem → ten. Learn the meaning together with its grammar clue.
quinque → five. Learn the meaning together with its grammar clue.
and → et. Spelling and the complete Latin form matter.
not → non. Spelling and the complete Latin form matter.
now → nunc. Spelling and the complete Latin form matter.

detailedExplanation: This note supports 14 source-backed questions on Miscellaneous words.
Identify the grammatical cue, retrieve the complete form independently and verify every ending before using the item in context.
examTips: Mark the finite verb first, then use noun endings to assign subject, object and recipient roles.
Normal Latin word order can vary; the case, number, gender, person and tense endings cannot.
For English to Latin, build each required form before arranging the sentence.
